from pathlib import Path
programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u089/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not cells:
        return [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]

    # Full horizontal bars encode a repeating sequence of row colors.
    bars = [(r, {grid[r][c] for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0})
            for r in range(h)
            if sum(grid[r][c] != 0 for c in range(w)) >= max(2, w * 0.7)]
    if bars and all(len(colors) == 1 for _, colors in bars):
        period = len(bars)
        values = {r % period: next(iter(colors)) for r, colors in bars}
        return [[values.get(r % period, 0) for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Otherwise each diagonal track is one position in the repeating tile.
    minus_tracks = {c - r for r, c, _ in cells}
    plus_tracks = {c + r for r, c, _ in cells}
    if len(minus_tracks) <= len(plus_tracks):
        coordinate = lambda r, c: c - r
        tracks = minus_tracks
    else:
        coordinate = lambda r, c: c + r
        tracks = plus_tracks
    period = len(tracks)
    values = {}
    for r, c, color in cells:
        residue = coordinate(r, c) % period
        if residue in values and values[residue] != color:
            raise ValueError("inconsistent diagonal encoding")
        values[residue] = color
    return [[values.get(coordinate(r, c) % period, 0) for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(h)]
'''
program_path = programs / 'task-b62cfe98.py'
program_path.write_text(code)
print(program_path)
